## Installation

1. Download and install the [True Crime: New York City Widescreen Fix](https://fusionfix.io/wfp#truecrimenyc), or the required [ASI Loader](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader).
2. Download [Xbox Rain Droplets for True Crime New York City](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/XboxRainDroplets/releases/download/tcnyc/TrueCrimeNewYorkCity.XboxRainDroplets.zip) and put the `.asi` file into the `scripts` folder.
3. Launch the game - the drops of the effect are visible while it rains.

## Notes

- Change the settings on [fusionfix.io](https://fusionfix.io) or in FusionFixHub; changes apply while the game runs. They are stored in the `.cfg` next to the plugin.
